goal_title: Migrate my-pa to the canonical PostgreSQL metadata and knowledge store
schema_version_note: Raised from 1 to 2. Version 1 stored an exact current_baseline SHA/tree inside the committed record. Version 2 records runtime Git as the authority for exact current identity and stores only a historical record_base for this change.

repository_identity_resolution.rule: Every future authorization must resolve and bind the current repository identity at authorization time. No committed predecessor SHA is current authority.

reconciled_by.reason: The prior closeout-correction record embedded 3e5aad7b… as continuously current baseline. After the closeout correction squash-merged as 178a7e24…, that embedded SHA became stale and would become stale again if simply replaced. This record removes exact-current-commit semantics from committed goal state.

last_closed_work_item.note: Historical merge identity of the original WP-P00-01 squash merge (PR #8). Not current repository authority.

successor_activation.precondition: Final WP-P00-01 closeout remains blocked until MYPA-WP-P00-01-FINAL-CLOSEOUT-F-001 is independently reviewed as resolved. No successor authorization is requested or activated by this correction.

historical_authorizations.note: Historical. Superseded as current state authority; retained for provenance. This authorization is consumed and grants nothing.
Historical closeout-correction authorization. Consumed by the squash merge at 178a7e24…. Retained for provenance; grants nothing.

invalidation_rule: Any identity, scope, acceptance, or mutation-limit drift invalidates a bound authorization when runtime Git differs from the exact identity recorded in that authorization's external activation package. Committed goal-state records do not store continuously current SHA/tree and therefore do not become stale merely because main advances.
